landscape.label: Why Window Film Here
landscape.title: How Oakland Weather Decides Which Window Film You Need
landscape.say: Oakland does not have one climate. It has a gradient. On a July morning the marine layer can sit over West Oakland and Jack London Square while Montclair is already in full sun, and by mid-afternoon the fog has usually pulled back toward the Golden Gate.

landscape.say: For homes: Home Tinting: Whole-house window tinting matched room by room, with stronger film on west-facing glass and clear or light film where you want the view and daylight left untouched. Heat Control: Film that rejects solar heat on the windows that overheat after 3 p.m., the ones facing west over the flats or out toward the bay from the hills. UV Protection: Nearly clear film that blocks about 99 percent of ultraviolet light, slowing the fading of fir floors, rugs, art and upholstery without changing how the glass looks. Privacy: Frosted, reflective and gradient films for bathrooms, street-facing bedrooms and ground-floor units where houses sit close together and sidewalks run right past the glass.

landscape.say: For businesses: Storefront: High-visibility film for shop windows that cuts heat and fading while keeping displays easy to see from the sidewalk on Telegraph, Grand Avenue and beyond. Commercial Security: Safety and security film for storefronts and offices, with optional attachment systems that anchor the film to the frame and slow smash-and-grab entry. Anti-Graffiti: Clear sacrificial film that takes tags, scratches and acid etching so the glass underneath does not. Decorative & Frosted Glass: Frosted and decorative glass film for offices, clinics, restaurants and lobbies, including cut logos, stripes and full-height privacy panels.

landscape.label: Local Know-How
landscape.title: Window Film for Oakland's Older Houses and Newer Glass
landscape.say: Oakland's housing stock is a big reason film makes sense here. West Oakland still has rows of Victorians with tall double-hung sashes. Rockridge, Temescal and Glenview are full of Craftsman bungalows and brown-shingle houses, many with their original wavy glass.

landscape.label: How It Works
landscape.title: How an install works

tiles.s: Use the quote form to tell them the address
They confirm glass type, frame condition and orientation
Film needs time to cure, longer in Oakland's cool

landscape.say: Here's how an install works. First, use the quote form to tell them the address, roughly how many windows, which way they face and what is bothering you. Then, they confirm glass type, frame condition and orientation, then show you film samples against your actual windows. On install day, installers clean each pane, cut film to the glass edge and squeegee out the mounting solution. Finally, film needs time to cure, longer in Oakland's cool, damp months than in September heat.

landscape.say: Common questions: How much does window film cost in Oakland? Price depends on the type of film, the total square footage, how many separate panes there are, and access. Will window tinting make my Oakland house dark? Not unless you choose a dark film. Can I put window film on a historic Oakland home? Film is applied to the inside of the glass and can be removed, so it usually leaves original sashes and trim untouched.
